```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        python-version: [3.8, 3.9, 3.10]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        activate-environment: true
        ignore-empty-workdir: false
        enable-cache: true
        github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install -r dev-requirements.txt

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        uv run pytest
        uv run ruff check
        uv run ruff format --check

    - name: Check device availability
      run: |
        python - <<EOF
import torch
print("CUDA available:", torch.cuda.is_available())
print("MPS available:", torch.backends.mps.is_available())
EOF

    - name: Device selection test
      if: matrix.os == 'macos-latest'
      run: |
        python - <<EOF
import sys
sys.path.append('.')
from device_utils import detect_best_device
print("Best device:", detect_best_device())
EOF
```
